home.title: Understand your money before it controls your month.
home.subtitle: Finance Tracker helps you organize accounts, record transactions, and see exactly where your money goes.
home.description: Use one place to monitor balances, group expenses by category, follow savings goals, and make better day-to-day financial decisions without juggling spreadsheets.

accounts.label: Account overview
accounts.copy: See your current account situation at a glance and switch between accounts from the dashboard.

insights.label: Spending insights
insights.copy: Track income, expenses, and category trends so you can understand your habits faster.

goals.label: Savings progress
goals.copy: Set targets, monitor progress, and stay focused on the purchases or plans that matter most.

featuresIntro.title: Everything you need to manage personal finances with less friction.
featuresIntro.subtitle: The app is designed to make daily money tracking easier, clearer, and more useful from the first account you add.

tracking.title: Track transactions
tracking.subtitle: Add income and expenses quickly so every movement is recorded in the right place.

categories.title: Organize by category
categories.subtitle: Group spending by category to see what is driving your monthly expenses.

balances.title: Monitor account balances
balances.subtitle: Keep an updated overview of each account without checking multiple sources.

charts.title: Financial charts and insights
charts.subtitle: Use reports and visuals to understand trends, compare periods, and spot changes.

goals.title: Savings goals
goals.subtitle: Create targets for important purchases and follow your progress over time.

howItWorks.title: A simple flow that turns daily tracking into useful decisions.
howItWorks.subtitle: You do not need a complex setup to start understanding your finances.

step1.title: Create your account
step1.subtitle: Sign up and add the financial accounts you want to track.

step2.title: Add your transactions
step2.subtitle: Record income and expenses with dates, amounts, and categories.

step3.title: Visualize your spending
step3.subtitle: Review balances, summaries, and charts to see what changed.

step4.title: Track your savings goals
step4.subtitle: Set targets and follow progress toward upcoming plans or purchases.

benefits.title: Built to make financial decisions feel clearer and more manageable.
benefits.subtitle: Finance Tracker gives new users a practical starting point for building better money habits.
benefits.control: Gain more control over your spending with a clear record of each transaction.
benefits.clarity: Understand where your money goes by reviewing categories, balances, and trends.
benefits.planning: Plan savings goals with visible targets instead of keeping rough estimates in mind.
benefits.confidence: Make better financial decisions with a dashboard that turns raw numbers into context.
